result.one_liner: CRM and sales platform for managing customer relationships, sales pipelines, marketing, and customer service operations.

evidence.quote: HubSpot supports two ways to authenticate calls to its APIs: OAuth, and private app access tokens.
The HubSpot CRM API is available on every plan, including the Free tier
All of the HubSpot APIs are organized around REST. The GraphQL API provides a single, unified way to fetch data
The API itself is free on every plan, including the free tier, with no separate API access fee

result.notes: API is free on all tiers including free plan. Private app tokens and OAuth are primary auth methods; legacy API keys deprecated in late 2022. Rate limits scale by subscription tier (free: 100 req/10s, ~250k calls/day). Buildable as agent toolkit with self-serve credentials and no approval requirements.
